Inference

  • Voice AI Cloud Managed inference on AssemblyAI’s cloud, with unlimited concurrency for production traffic.
  • Self-hosted Run our models in your own VPC or on-prem, with full control of your data.

Models

  • Universal-3.6 Pro Our most accurate speech-to-text model for recorded audio.
  • Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime Our most accurate model for voice agents, in real time.
  • AssemblyAI-TTS-1 New Text-to-speech built for voice agents, trained on millions of real phone calls.

APIs

  • Pre-recorded Speech-to-Text API Transcribe audio and video files with speaker labels and formatting.
  • Realtime Speech-to-Text API Stream audio in and get transcripts back as people speak.
  • Sync Speech-to-Text API Send a short clip and get finished text in the same request.
  • Speech Understanding API Summaries, sentiment, entities and more, built on your transcripts.
  • Guardrails Detect and redact PII and unsafe content in voice data.
  • Text-to-Speech API New Natural, low-latency text-to-speech built for voice agents.
  • LLM Gateway Open and frontier LLMs that perform best on voice tasks.
  • Dictation API Add dictation anywhere your users type.

Solutions

  • Voice Agents Speech-to-text and text-to-speech tuned for live calls.
  • Meeting Notetakers Accurate transcripts and summaries for every meeting.
  • Agent Assist Real-time guidance for human agents on live calls.
  • Medical Transcription Clinical-grade accuracy for drugs, dosages and procedures.
  • Dictation Turn spoken drafts into clean written text.
  • AI Scribes Ambient clinical notes from patient conversations.

Modes

  • Medical mode Clinical vocabulary for drugs, dosages and procedures.
  • Veterinarian mode Terminology tuned for veterinary care.
  • Legal mode Soon Precision for proceedings, depositions and contracts.
